formula: small = random min_value to max_value (1 to 3), big = random min_value2 to max_value2 (22 to 25), attack = randomly small OR big (never in between)
what_it_does: Wild flames! The fire rolls a small number (1 to 3) and a big number (22 to 25), then randomly uses ONE of them. It either fizzles (1 to 3) or blazes (22 to 25), never anything in between!
Shoot lightning bolts at the enemy. Your attack takes a random amount between 8 and 14 health from the other player.
Call down meteors from the sky. Your attack takes a random amount between 5 and 18 health from the other player.
Throw exploding potion flasks. Your attack ALWAYS takes exactly 10 health from the other player.
Fire a rain of glowing arrows. Your attack takes a random amount between 0 and 36 health from the other player. It could miss completely or hit huge!

formula: your health + random min_value to max_value (0 to 50)
what_it_does: A green glow heals you a random amount between 0 and 50 health, before you attack. Works once per game.

formula: knocked out this round: your health = max_value (18), not knocked out: your health + min_value (5)
what_it_does: Switch it on for one round. If you get knocked out that round, you come back with 18 health. If you don't get knocked out, you get +5 health instead. Works once per game.

formula: your health increase = their attack x max_value (1)
what_it_does: Hide in your tent this round. Whatever attack the other player hits you with turns into health for you instead. Works once per game.
A cute dog distracts the other player, so their attack this round does nothing to you. Works once per game.
Rovey rolls in next to you and DOUBLES your attack this round. Works once per game.

formula: their damage = your attack + their attack x max_value (1) bounced back to them
what_it_does: You salsa dance after you attack. Whatever attack the other player throws at you this round bounces back and hits them instead. Works once per game.

formula: pick = random (your health ability OR your other special ability), pick gets +1 use
what_it_does: Abracadabra! Magic randomly picks your health ability or your other special ability and doubles it, so it can be used one extra time. You can use the extra one starting next round. Works once per game.

formula: start of round: if boy health is under min_value (18) and girl health is over min_value2 (36), boy attack x max_value (2) for the rest of the game
what_it_does: At the start of a round, if the Boy Scout has under 18 health and the Girl Scout has over 36 health, he drinks his rage potion and his attacks hit 2 times harder for the rest of the game.

formula: start of round: if boy health is under min_value (9) and girl health is over min_value2 (18), boy attack x max_value (2) for the rest of the game
what_it_does: At the start of a round, if the Boy Scout has under 9 health and the Girl Scout has over 18 health, he drinks his rage potion and his attacks hit 2 times harder for the rest of the game.

formula: start of round: if girl health is more than boy health x min_value (1.72), boy attack x max_value (2) for the rest of the game
what_it_does: At the start of a round, if the Girl Scout has 72% more health than the Boy Scout, he drinks his rage potion and his attacks hit 2 times harder for the rest of the game.

formula: after the girl attacks: if girl health minus boy health is more than min_value (36), boy attack x max_value (2) for the rest of the game
what_it_does: If the Girl Scout is ever winning by more than 36 health, from a big attack or from healing, he drinks his rage potion before he hits back and his attacks hit 2 times harder for the rest of the game.
